remarks: This charming Norwalk cottage has been thoughtfully renovated, blending classic character with fresh, modern updates throughout. The newly remodeled kitchen has been opened up to create a bright, seamless flow between the kitchen, dining, and living spaces. Beautifully refinished hardwood floors run throughout the home.  Two newly renovated full bathrooms offer a sleek, modern style, while the finished walk-up attic has been transformed into a primary suite, offering privacy on its own level. Two additional bedrooms complete the main floor. A picturesque screened-in porch extends the living space and offers the perfect spot for morning coffee, summer dinners, or relaxing while overlooking the yard. Downstairs, a finished bonus room provides even more flexibility and can easily serve as a home office, playroom, guest space, or gym. Complete with an attached one-car garage and beautiful level yard, 20 Woodlawn Avenue combines the character of a classic bungalow with thoughtful renovations and flexible living space across three levels.  Recent Upgrades Include: New Roof, New HVAC.
